Yes — that lands nicely. When I read the last one and the list emptied out, I got a little checkmark and "Nothing waiting for you — your Read later list is clear," which feels like a small pat on the back rather than a scary blank page. And it reminds me how to add things back with the clock, so I'm not left wondering how the list refills. That's a positive, encouraging note to end on.

And "Browse all bookmarks" is the right next step — once I've finished my reading pile, the natural thing is to wander back into my whole library, and that button takes me straight there. Good.
